gloss: sarcasm, irony; ironic, contrary to expectations

definitions.explanation: A mocking or ironic remark, or the use of words to convey the opposite of their literal meaning.
A situation where the outcome is contrary to what was expected, often in a cruel or unfortunate way.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{皮肉|ひにく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{込|こ}めて→込める：01945_komeru⟧「⟦すばらしい→素晴らしい：01119_subarashii⟧⟦ね→ね：09474_ne⟧」⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}った→言う：00515_iu⟧。
{皮肉|ひにく}な⟦ことに→ことに：09581_kotoni⟧、⟦{医者|いしゃ}→医者：02847_isha⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{病気|びょうき}→病気：00771_byouki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧。
⟦そんな→そんな：01645_sonna⟧{皮肉|ひにく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{言|い}わないで→言う：00515_iu⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please don't make such sarcastic remarks.

examples.japanese: ⟦{努力|どりょく}→努力：03490_doryoku⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{失敗|しっぱい}→失敗：01636_shippai⟧⟦し→する：00392_suru⟧、⟦{何|なに}→何：00498_nani⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦しなかった→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{成功|せいこう}→成功：02638_seikou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{皮肉|ひにく}な⟦{話|はなし}→話：01496_hanashi⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。

examples.english: How ironic that the building that burned down was the fire station.

notes:
{皮肉|ひにく} can function as both a noun and a na-adjective. It covers both verbal sarcasm and situational irony.

Common patterns:
- {皮肉|ひにく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{言|い}う→言う：00515_iu⟧ (to say something sarcastic)
- {皮肉|ひにく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{込|こ}めて→込める：01945_komeru⟧ (with sarcasm, sarcastically)
- {皮肉|ひにく}な⟦ことに→ことに：09581_kotoni⟧ (ironically)
- {皮肉|ひにく}な⟦{結果|けっか}→結果：02486_kekka⟧ (ironic result)

The word literally combines ⟦{皮|かわ}→皮：02187_kawa⟧ (skin) and ⟦{肉|にく}→肉：02240_niku⟧ (flesh/meat), suggesting something superficial or surface-level, hence the meaning of saying the opposite of what one means.
